rule: 2 Oct decision: one PRIMARY source, typed (g1_tracker.single_primary_source); model-read, gate-verified (scripts/g1_trial_acquire.py)

model.outcome_as_stated: MADRS Total Score: Change From Baseline to Day 28 of Double-Blind Phase
model.population_as_stated: all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication and (efficacy)/or (safety) 1 dose of oral antidepressant
model.scope_span: Eligible patients were randomized (1:1:1) based on a computer-generated randomization schedule to double-blind nasal spray treatment with either 1 of 2 fixed doses of esketamine (56 or 84 mg) or placebo.
model.why: Fixed-dose multi-arm trial; protocol_arm_object is null, so the protocol's multi-arm guard refuses extraction. Additionally, reported between-group effects are adjusted LS mean differences, not the requested observed-case raw change-score MD.

model.outcome_as_stated: Change From Baseline to Endpoint in Montgomery Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) Total Score During Induction (IND) Phase
model.timepoint_as_stated: Baseline (IND) up to the Endpoint (last post-baseline assessment value during 4 weeks of IND phase)
model.population_as_stated: Full (IND) analysis set, open-label induction participants
model.scope_span: open-label IND phase (for direct-entry and transferred-entry non-responder participants)
model.why: Open-label induction conflicts with the required double-blind design. The posted MADRS endpoint also uses LOCF rather than observed cases; no randomized experimental-versus-control result is supplied.
